title: Verses.3
tagline: A poet's paradise, hoping to utilize the web3 technology for creating a better experience for writers and readers.
description:
Welcome to Verses.3, a social network project that aims to turn readers into poets while rewarding them for their engagement on a Web3 platform. It provides a decentralized platform where users can take ownership of their content and interactions. This allows for a more transparent and fair system where users can earn rewards based on their contributions and the engagement they generate. We are hoping to actively build this project and proposed list of future updates is as follow - 

> Improving The UI

> Comment Options

> My Favorites Tab on Profile

> Edit a Verse

> Add Existing Verses To New Collections

> Add A Feature of Topics like Hashtags

> View Profiles Of Others
how_its_made: We have built a Social Network platform for the poets to display and publish their work. We have used Polybase for the data storage and the framework used for the front-end is ReactJS. We have used the Polybase/Auth & Polybase/React for connecting and interacting with the backend.
